variants.name: detach every incident direction and kind

vars.query: UNWIND [1,2,3] AS x MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n

variants.name: explicit incident relationships reversed target order
plain node with null optional relationship

vars.query: MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-() DELETE r, n
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'left'})-[]->(m:DeleteNode {name:'right'}) DELETE n DETACH DELETE m
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) WITH n DETACH DELETE n
MATCH (n:DeleteNode {name:'target'}) DETACH DELETE n WITH 1 AS x MATCH (m:DeleteNode {name:'isolated'}) DELETE m
MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n ORDER BY n.name SKIP 1 LIMIT 1 DELETE n
MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n ORDER BY n.name LIMIT 0 DELETE n
MATCH (n:DeleteNode) WITH n WHERE n.name='isolated' DELETE n
